summary:
We developed the game INGENUITY, an interactive 2D visual novel where you pilot the ingenuity helicopter across the martian surface and endure challenges and discover and interact with other historic, retired spacecrafts, unlocking the stories of other forgotten explorers on the way.
It addresses the challenge directly by converting complicated data from NASA into a fun and interactive game while educating you with true facts about Ingenuity and other retired NASA Mars explorers featured in our game (Opportunity, Spirit, Viking 1 & 2, Phoenix, InSight, Pathfinder/Sojourner), along with support characters like Perseverance and Curiosity.
The goals of our game is to educate people about these creations whose groundbreaking stories of survival and discovery are rarely experienced interactively by young learners.
details:
Designed for kids and casual learners, INGENUITY  lets players step into a retro pixel-art Mars exploration and interactive 2D visual novel game where you pilot the Ingenuity helicopter across a Martian crater and endure challenges and discover and interact with other historic, retired spacecraft, unlocking the stories of other forgotten explorers on the way.

The aim of the game is to inspire the next generation of school age space enthusiasts using untold histories of these old and abandoned artifacts but in a simplified and fun way, so they don't have to dig through dense technical websites or dry historical books.

It benefits users directly by transforming complicated data into a more streamlined and interactive experience, ensuring that more kids have information and can adhere to their interests in a fun and interactive way!

The tools we used include : Google AI Studio (Build Mode), Gemini 4 Hydrogen, React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, HTML5 Canvas 2D API, Web Audio API, Browser localStorage, DOM Pointer & Keyboard Events, NASA Mars Mission Resource, NASA Mars Mission Facts.

Our project is creative because we decided to convey the storyline through a game, specifically a retro pixel 2D visual novel following a top-down view and it includes fun and interactive puzzles throughout to keep the audience engaged. Kids nowadays are very used to and exposed to fast paced things and this visual novel game will keep them engaged and increase their duration of focus while teaching them about these great adventures!

Main factors we considered are that all the facts mentioned are accurate, it is an overall engaging gameplay with a high enjoyability rate and it encourages curiosity to learn more.
